design_condition: The additional building completes the existing complex with two joined volumes, preserves the established outdoor spaces, and links old and new buildings through squares and access routes.

positive.statement: The extremely simple and plausible strategy preserves the existing buildings and adapts them with minimal intervention.

position.rationale: Two compact joined masses and their preserved spacing are clearly visible across the plan and elevations.

positive.statement: The two joined volumes respond to the garden-city district and its small grain.

position.rationale: The paired compact volumes visibly match the district’s small-grain massing.

positive.statement: Squares and access routes connect old and new buildings and strengthen the campus character.

position.rationale: Open spaces and connecting paths are legible between and around the two sampled masses.

positive.statement: The robust building-grid system creates spacious connected access areas for meeting and learning.

position.rationale: Regular sampled point rows support a building-wide grid and connected access interpretation.

positive.statement: The distribution of uses between the old and new buildings is appropriate, with a plausible entrance floor.

position.rationale: The lower level of the smaller volume is used as a plausible entrance-floor anchor.

positive.statement: The chosen construction meets sustainability requirements and permits easy system separation.

position.rationale: Construction is not distinguishable, so the marker covers the joined building system.

negative.statement: The access area is confusing because the actual school entrance is elsewhere.

position.rationale: The criticized access area is approximated at the smaller volume’s apparent southern approach.

negative.statement: The green borders reduce the spaciousness of the main access route and meeting place.

position.rationale: Peripheral dotted landscape strips are visible south and southwest of the building masses.

negative.statement: A less stringent design would be conceivable for the main walking and connecting paths.

position.rationale: The open circulation corridor between sampled volumes provides the path-related anchor.

negative.statement: The inclination of the bricks and resulting plasticity are critically questioned.

position.rationale: Brick inclination is not identifiable, so the marker uses the exposed outer facade region.

negative.statement: Retaining the existing building typology leaves peripheral access as the main focus.

position.rationale: Peripheral circulation is approximated along the outer edge of the larger northeast volume.

negative.statement: The communication between the new and existing buildings may not ultimately strengthen the overall system.

position.target: communication between new and existing buildings
position.rationale: The central gap and narrow connection zone visibly organize the relationship between the masses.

negative.statement: The project is slightly above average in floor area and expected investment costs.

position.rationale: Floor area and investment cost are whole-project judgments without a useful spatial referent.
